pairs: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen in deserto Sinai in tabernaculo fœderis,
And the Lord spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the covenant,
on the first day of the second month,
anno altero egressionis eorum ex Ægypto,
in the year after their departure from Egypt,
Tollite summam universæ congregationis filiorum Israël per cognationes
“Take a total of the entire assembly of the sons of Israel,
and the names of each one,
of whomever is of the male sex,
of all the able-bodied men out of Israel,
et numerabitis eos per turmas suas,
and you shall number them by their companies,
Eruntque vobiscum principes tribuum ac domorum in cognationibus suis,
And there shall be with you the leaders of the tribes, as well as of the houses, in their kinships,
the names of whom are these:
And from the sons of Joseph:
Hi nobilissimi principes multitudinis per tribus
These are the very noble leaders of the multitude,
and the heads of the army of Israel.
et Aaron cum omni vulgi multitudine:
with all the multitude of the common people,
et congregaverunt primo die mensis secundi,
and they gathered them together on the first day of the second month,
taking a census of them by kinships,
et nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra,
and the names of each one from twenty years and above,
just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
And they were numbered in the desert of Sinai.
De Ruben primogenito Israëlis per generationes
by their generations and families and houses,
and the names of each head,
omne quod sexus est masculini a vigesimo anno
of all who were of the male sex,
there were forty-six thousand five hundred.
ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina
and the houses of their kinships,
having been counted by the names and heads of each one,
omne quod sexus est masculini a vigesimo anno
of all who were of the male sex,
there were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
De filiis Gad per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a viginti annis et supra, omnes qui ad bella procederent,
Of the sons of Gad, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who could go forth to war,
there were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
and the houses of their kinships,
per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno
by the names of each one,
omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,
of all who were able to go forth to war,
recensiti sunt septuaginta quatuor millia sexcenti.
there were counted seventy-four thousand six hundred.
per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum,
by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships,
per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra,
by the names of each one, from twenty years and above,
of all who could go forth to war,
recensiti sunt quinquaginta quatuor millia quadringenti.
there were counted fifty-four thousand four hundred.
De filiis Zabulon per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

Of the sons of Zebulon, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who were able to go forth to war,
there were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
De filiis Joseph, filiorum Ephraim per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

From the sons of Joseph, of the sons of Ephraim, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who were able to go forth to war,
there were forty thousand five hundred.
Porro filiorum Manasse per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a viginti annis et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

Furthermore, of the sons of Manasseh, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who were able to go forth to war,
there were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
De filiis Benjamin per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

Of the sons of Benjamin, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who were able to go forth to war,
there were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
De filiis Dan per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

Of the sons of Dan, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who were able to go forth to war,
there were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
De filiis Aser per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt per nomina singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

Of the sons of Asher, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who were able to go forth to war,
there were forty thousand and one thousand five hundred.
De filiis Nephthali per generationes et familias ac domos cognationum suarum recensiti sunt nominibus singulorum a vigesimo anno et supra, omnes qui poterant ad bella procedere,

Of the sons of Naphtali, by their generations and families, and the houses of their kinships, having been counted by the names of each one, from twenty years and above, of all who were able to go forth to war,
there were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
These are the ones who were numbered by Moses
and the twelve leaders of Israel,
each one by the houses of their kinships.
Fueruntque omnis numerus filiorum Israël per domos
And the entire number of the sons of Israel by their houses and families,
et familias suas a vigesimo anno
who were able to go forth to war,
sexcenta tria millia virorum quingenti quinquaginta.
six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
Levitæ autem in tribu familiarum suarum non sunt numerati cum eis.
But the Levites in the tribes of their families were not numbered with them.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
“Do not number the tribe of Levi,
neque pones summam eorum cum filiis Israël:
neither shall you take a total of them with the sons of Israel.
sed constitue eos super tabernaculum testimonii et cuncta vasa ejus,
But appoint them over the tabernacle of the testimony, and all its vessels,
and whatever pertains to the ceremonies.
Ipsi portabunt tabernaculum et omnia utensilia ejus: et erunt in ministerio,
They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles. And they shall be for the ministry,
and they shall encamp all around the tabernacle.
Cum proficiscendum fuerit, deponent Levitæ tabernaculum;
When you would depart, the Levites shall take down the tabernacle.
When you are to make camp, they shall set it up.
Any outsider who will approach it shall be killed.
Metabuntur autem castra filii Israël unusquisque per turmas
Now the sons of Israel shall make camp,
each one by his companies and bands,
Porro Levitæ per gyrum tabernaculi figent tentoria,
Moreover, the Levites shall fix their tents all around the tabernacle,
ne fiat indignatio super multitudinem filiorum Israël,
lest there be an indignation over the multitude of the sons of Israel.
et excubabunt in custodiis tabernaculi testimonii.
And they shall stand watch as guardians over the tabernacle of the testimony.”
Fecerunt ergo filii Israël juxta omnia quæ præceperat Dominus Moysi.
Therefore, the sons of Israel acted according to everything that the Lord had instructed Moses.
